_comment: Golden fixture for AC-1 intraday guard_alpha saved-dollars formula: saved = (at_return - current_return) / 100 * position_value. Positive when bot locked in gains that the held position has since given up.

cases.name: bot_locked_in_gains_held_fell
cases.description: Bot exited at +2.5%; held fell to -0.5%. Divergence = 3pp on $10k = $300 saved.

cases.name: bot_locked_in_gains_held_also_positive_but_lower
cases.description: Bot exited at +3.0%; held is at +1.0%. Divergence = 2pp on $5k = $100 saved.

cases.name: held_above_exit_price
cases.description: Bot exited at +1.0%; held is now at +2.5%. Bot missed gains. Divergence negative.

cases.name: no_divergence_exact_match
cases.description: Bot exited and held at exactly same return. Zero alpha.

cases.name: large_positive_divergence
cases.description: Bot exited at +5.0%; held collapsed to -3.0%. 8pp on $50k = $4000 saved.
